description: Does this wallet already have the required proofs? Returns pass or fail, not records. To read proofs, use proofable_proofs_get. Omit the wallet when signed in.

gateId.description: Optional hosted gate or listing id. Signed-in owners still get eligible + matchedCount only.

handle.description: Optional handle filter for handle-based verifiers.

minCount.description: Minimum number of matching proofs. Default 1.

namespace.description: Optional namespace filter for handle checks.

requireAll.description: Require all listed verifiers. Default false accepts any one.

wallet.description: Wallet or DID to verify. Omit when signed in to use the current account.

name: proofable_proofs_check
